austin.summary: Austin, you drafted dead last in the snake order and somehow walked away with a wall. Four of 4 still in the game, 16 counted points, tied for rank 1 of 5, and two badges on the mantel: Untouchable — 4 boots, none yours — and Wire-to-Wire, because you've led or co-led after every single elimination. Ep 3 gave you +8, your best week yet. Draft GPA sits at 3.75. That, my friend, is a quiet masterpiece.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Linnea, Jenna, Carter and Eric are each sitting on 4 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced roster where Eric at pick #16 is the steal of the draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: You haven't lost a castaway yet, so the only soft spot is Linnea's B grade in a lineup where everyone else earned an A.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are 98 points still on the table and the leader has 16 — so watch whether Jenna's years of planning and Eric's fast-built bonds keep this four-headed monster co-leading after the next elimination.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this season — Aaliyah went home in Episode 1, and that First Blood badge is yours forever. But look closer: three of your four are still out there, all three tied at the top with 4 pts apiece, and your draft GPA of 3 says you knew what you were doing. You sit at 12 counted points, rank 5 of 5, with the leader at 16 and 76 points still on the table. That's nothing.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kilby at pick #18 is the steal of your draft — a game designer who's wanted this his whole life, sitting at 4 pts and rank 1 of 21, right alongside Cristian and Alexis.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that stung — first voted out, 0 pts, rank 21 of 21, grade F — and it's why Episode 1 was your worst week at +3.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your Savu pair, Cristian and Alexis, are sharing a tribe — keep an eye on whether that double-dip keeps delivering weeks like Ep 3's +6.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick and you came out swinging — and here's the twist: your best story is the leftover. Sharonda at #21 ranks 1, and she's doing exactly what a steal is supposed to do. You sit rank 3 of 5 with 15 counted points, raw 17, Rob dropped, and 3 of 5 still breathing. The leader has 16. That's nothing. With 76 points still on the table, you are very much in this game.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda, Mike and Jelly are all sitting at 4 pts and rank 1 of 21 — three co-leaders hauling your scoreboard, with Mike and Sharonda both pulling grade A marks.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 is your reach — ranks 18 of 21, grade F, 3rd voted out in Ep 3 — and Rob's quit that same episode left him dropped at 2 pts under the best-4 rule.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You've already got Torch Collector with 2 torches snuffed and Idol Whisperer with 2 found, so watch whether your remaining three keep digging up advantages and build on that Ep 3 high of +7.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and you built a team that refuses to quit. You sit rank 4 of 5 with 13 counted points, and the leader has just 16 — that's nothing out here. Three of your four are still in the game, your draft GPA is 2.5 this early, and Episode 3 handed you your best week at +6 after Episode 2 scraped by at +3. With 76 points still on the table, you are absolutely in contention.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin, Ori and Brady are each sitting on 4 pts and rank 1 of 21 — three A-and-C-graded engines pulling in the same direction.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana at pick #12 is the reach that stung, going out 2nd on Day 5 with 1 pts, rank 20 of 21 and a grade F.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Brady at pick #19 is your steal of the draft over on Toka — watch whether that lone wolf keeps pace with your Savu pair.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted 4th and somehow walked away with an entire tribe. Four castaways, all Toka, all still in the game at 4 of 4, all sitting at 4 pts and rank 1 of 21 — that's a clean sweep of a roster. You're tied at rank 1 of 5 with 16 counted points, you've gone Wire-to-Wire, and you're Untouchable: 4 boots, none of them yours. Ep 3 gave you +8. The tribe is yours. For now.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An are each at 4 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, with Thien An at pick #17 standing as the steal of your draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Every name you own wears the same buff, so Toka's fortunes are your fortunes, and Lewis Kelly's B grade is the softest mark on an otherwise A-heavy board.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are 98 points still on the table and the leader has 16 — watch whether that Untouchable badge survives the first time Toka has to make a hard call.
